decision.ACCEPT: At a frozen look, multiplicity-corrected interval lower bound > 0.
decision.CONTINUE: Interval includes 0 and fewer than 3000 scored games per arm have been reached.
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: At 3000 scored games per arm, interval still includes 0.
decision.REJECT: At a frozen look, multiplicity-corrected interval upper bound < 0.

planned_looks.ordering: chronological recorded game order within each arm

prerequisite: Run only if clustered LOCAL_CONFIRMATION does not establish local regression.
primary_metric: ISS per-game deployment score, B1 minus B0
safety_and_validity: Infrastructure/protocol failures are excluded from strength scoring until attributed.
External gate games remain frozen evaluation evidence until the gate decision.
Named-opponent results are diagnostics; no single opponent defines acceptance.
Local/offline metrics cannot alter this external decision rule after external scoring begins.
Each primary game identifies both non-SkatAI opponents; a single named opponent is never treated as the complete table opposition.

stratification.estimator: weighted difference of arm means within opponent-stack x SkatAI-seat strata
stratification.opponent_field_mapping: Implementation uses ISSGameOutcome.opponent to hold canonical opponent-stack labels.
stratification.stratum_weight: combined B0+B1 scored-game count in the matched opponent-stack x seat stratum
stratification.unmatched_strata: not used in the primary estimator until both arms have observations

uncertainty.method: stratified nonparametric bootstrap within arm x opponent x seat cells
